footwork_summary.note: Lower-body pose evidence. Rhythm describes hip-height oscillations; it is not a verified bounce count or foot-contact measurement.

gesture_model.reason: No gesture model has been trained and promoted.

activity_model.reason: No activity phase model has been trained and promoted.

candidates.label: Peak stance → return to calibrated guard band

warnings: Preprocessed low-resolution archival demonstration. Unsupported for personal coaching; inspect overlays and QA reasons only.
Angles and torso tilt are 2D estimates, not spinal straightness or a technique verdict.
Arm extension is measured at a proposed movement onset, not weapon contact or attack intent.
Exercise regions and lunge-like reps are unvalidated pose-based suggestions. Review every interval.
The pipeline searches for a steady en-garde stance anywhere in the clip. Earlier walk-in footage is excluded from rep proposals.
Tracking quality is a visibility/presence proxy, not probability of correctness.
source_credit: MIT OpenCourseWare / PE.740 Fencing (Spring 2007) / Prof. Jaroslav Koniusz

movement_timeline.note: Movement suggestions need review. Phase peaks measure stance expansion, not landing or touch. Model scores are uncalibrated.

issues.tip: Film at 720p or higher; the shorter image dimension must be at least 480 pixels.
Keep one fencer's whole body visible, use brighter lighting, and avoid occlusion.
Move the camera farther back so head, feet, weapon hand, and the whole run-up stay in frame.
Use a textured, well-lit background and a fixed camera; camera stability could not be checked.

quality_gate.note: QA gates are project thresholds, not calibrated recognition accuracy. Geometric reacquisitions are not verified identity switches.
